_note: The IEEE 802.15.4 energy scanner (github.com/joakimeriksson/esp32, energy_scan) on the Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47: LVGL on the ST7789 over SPI2+GDMA, the WS2812 on the RMT, energy detect from the emulated 802.15.4 MAC with a moving synthetic 2.4 GHz picture. bb_init is the PHY blob's baseband calibration — hardware handshakes the model does not have; its address is the one in this build. BOOT (GPIO 9) switches all-channel / single-channel scanning.
